description.value:
Spending your action, you can lash out with one melee weapon attack against every creature within your reach, rolling a separate attack roll for each target. The first attack rolled carries a +1 bonus, and every subsequent attack's bonus climbs by another +1, stacking up to a cap of +6.

If you're wielding two light or vibro-weapons, or a single double-property weapon, that same escalating bonus also applies to your damage rolls, and you may use your bonus action to make use of Double- or Two-Weapon Fighting.

Once used, this feature can't be used again until you finish a short or long rest.
